mappingPolicy.rule: One public Design ID maps to at most one verified development public identity. Internal Figma anatomy, variant sets and slots are not additional mapping identities.
mappingPolicy.missingDevelopmentBehavior: Widget and Composite entries without a verified public runtime identity use ENGINEERING_GAP with developmentComponentId=null. LayoutHelper and Asset entries keep developmentComponentId=null and record their owner-specific consumerEngineeringStatus instead of requiring a QWidget class.

kindPolicy.existingEntries: Derive Widget versus Composite from the verified legacy engineering mapping, then reconcile the canonical identity with current Figma.

componentSetPolicy.rule: Every Figma Component Set must be referenced by exactly one Canonical Library entry or explicitly classified here. INTERNAL, PROPOSAL and RESIDUE sets never create a second public component identity.

tokenAuthority.limitation: A positive binding count proves traceability to a Figma variable, not complete role coverage or runtime token consumption.

engineeringEvidence.boundary: The 5 remaining ENGINEERING_GAP records are intentionally non-QWidget entries: 2 LayoutHelpers and 3 Assets. Their completion is recorded by owner-specific consumerEngineeringStatus=IMPLEMENTED; they must not be added to ComponentFactory or assigned fake QWidget identities.

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: QAction remains command identity and data authority; hover, active and keyboard highlight are transient native states, while MenuItem remains internal anatomy.
QAction and ComponentLab/Menu remain shared runtime authorities; open, hover, keyboard and disabled are native action states, while the corner widget content remains consumer-owned.
QAction remains shared command authority; QMainWindow owns real docking and floating lifecycle, while the Figma Placement axis is a deterministic appearance specimen.
QTabWidget owns page visibility, keyboard selection, close-request signaling and page attachment; generated pages own close confirmation, deletion and persistence. TabItem remains internal anatomy.
QToolBox owns single-current-page selection and attached item pages. All-collapsed and multi-open behavior belongs to Collapse, not ToolBox; ToolBoxItem remains internal anatomy.

Area and Placement are design previews only. QMainWindow owns actual docking and tabification; floating, allowedAreas and DockWidgetFeatures remain native runtime authority and are never inferred from Figma variant values.
Stable destinations, selection synchronization and page switching remain generated-page responsibilities; internal item sets remain SDK anatomy.
Search execution, notification data and profile-menu routing remain generated-page responsibilities.
Route resolution, permissions, active-route synchronization and page switching remain generated-page responsibilities.
